---
title: Smoke
author: Test Author
date: 2026-01-01
format:
  mcanouil-html: default
  mcanouil-revealjs: default
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: quarto
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The quarto preset reaches HTML, Reveal.js and Typst, and no opt-in tool leaves a marker.
        check: bash _checks/tokens.sh smoke quarto
    mcanouil-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<main']
        - ['class="light-content"', '<iconify-icon', 'data-prism=', 'sourceCode python cw-auto', 'data-veil-hidden', 'assets/typst-render/', 'gitlink-badge', 'mobile-toc/', 'preview-colour', 'collapse-output', 'quarto-remember']
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<section']
        - ['class="light-content"', '<iconify-icon', 'data-prism=', 'sourceCode python cw-auto', 'data-veil-hidden', 'assets/typst-render/', 'gitlink-badge', 'mobile-toc/', 'preview-colour', 'collapse-output', 'quarto-remember']
    mcanouil-typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['motif\(']
---

{{< include _smoke.qmd >}}
